caption: The drawing depicts a single sculptural object in the form of a high-heeled boot with a pointed toe, button detailing along the side, and a scalloped or zigzag edge at the top. The boot is dark in color, appearing to be rendered in shades of black and dark brown. It stands on a decorative plinth or pedestal with several tiers, each having scalloped and ridged edges, and the pedestal is composed of similarly dark tones. The object is centered on a plain, light beige background with no other elements present. In the lower right corner, there is a handwritten signature that reads "Sarkis Erganians" in reddish-brown ink.
title: Door Stop
